name: Casefile
tagline: Agents that explain why a Solana token dumped, and show the receipts.
track: The Agent That Can Explain Why

demo_cases.one_line: Insiders control 85.52% of supply, price fell 97.72%, and only about $2.4k liquidity remains with a danger-level low-liquidity risk, indicating a completed rug.
Price fell 93.54% with only thousands in liquidity and a danger-level low-liquidity risk, indicating a completed rug.
Only weak signal: mutable metadata; ample liquidity, no top-10 insiders, no mint/freeze authority.
No strong rug signals remain; only weak ratio and modest sell-pressure signals are present.

zetaris.role: data layer: the only component that fetches and shapes RugCheck and DexScreener data
features: Lightning REST tables created at runtime per token (DEXSCREENER_REST, RUGCHECK_REST)
SchemaStore views in container casefile (pairs, summary, holders, risks, insiders, markets, known_accounts, lockers)
Parquet evidence snapshots via RUN EXPORT TO STORAGE, registered as LIGHTNING FILESTORE tables in CASEFILE_SNAP
agents read only the snapshots: slices of the snapshot tables in each prompt, plus query_case for extra read-only SELECTs (snapshot tables only, serialized; unused in the demo runs)

meterless_nightshift.role: primary AI provider (Meterless Power Prompt contract: Runtime 1.4, provider contract v4)
meterless_nightshift.receipts: every call saved to runs/<case_id>/<run_id>/receipts.jsonl; receipt id + routed model (the model that answered) shown on every LLM step in the UI

nvidia_models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B
nvidia_models.note: routed_model records the model that answered; in the WIF demo run Nightshift consensus escalation answered one casefile-fast deployer call (claims D1, D2) with Super (receipt rcpt_req_oz1pxls2)

pre_existing_components: Zetaris platform (local Docker install) and zetaris-getting-started recipes and AGENTS.md rules (guidance; no code copied)
Meterless Power Prompt (provider contract v4) and H-MEM prompt, used as specifications
Meterless H-MEM reference implementation (Apache-2.0), adapted into casefile/hmem/ with attribution
NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B A3B and Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B A12B, via Nightshift
Open-source libraries: FastAPI, uvicorn, requests, python-dotenv, pytest, httpx, React 18.3.1, react-router-dom, Vite, TypeScript, Playwright, tsx
Claude Design export design/Casefile.html (UI design; EB Garamond and IBM Plex Mono fonts, SIL OFL)
build_window: 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-27; all project code written in this window
